book.name: DIYON
book.title: Yeisu Wasana Waiwaisana Diyon wana Leleli

content: Yeisu I Masal wana Tohago elal Talbwasiya
Sauga etega al Yeisu i masal al wana tohago elal Hoga Taibeliyas
ana talbwasiya. He i gan i ola hiwe.
Saimon Pita, Tomas (iya alana etega al Didimas), Nataniyel (iya gagama Kena Galili awanina), Sebedi natunau eluwa avaliyau ge tohago eluwa al hi mipamaisena.

Saimon Pita i baek alonau elal i ba, “Nau ya nana ya lologi.” Yaka heliya hi ba, “Ha nonowa aloma owa.” Inoke hi nok hi na hi gaiha wagaa, ge hi na hi logi matavi, yaa bulin o nige moti etega hi lologe.
Mweluluga sabwelu i haha, Yeisu i na i talmilil talbwasiya, yaa tohago nige hi aatena te iya Yeisu.
Inoke i yoga nok elal i ba, “Alowau, tab moti etega ku loge?” Anana hi lahe hi ba, “Nigeya.”

Yaka i baek elal i ba, “Wami vineya ku alipaloek waga bebena toto nimamiu labena awomiu elana, inoke moti enuna nihi ona.” Inoke vineya hi alipalo hogaa, ge nige bosowailiya nihi momol pahe waga gamwanaa, kaiwena moti hi gewi nabi hi ona.
Yaka Yeisu wana tohago toto i nunuwana-an nabiyan,
i baek Pita elana i ba, “Babala to!” Sauga Saimon Pita i hago tohago o i ba, “Babala to,” inoke ana kaliko toto i loho i teli, i ahe i galoi, i supeni lau hogaa ge i gayutuk.
Tohago gegewel al waga elana abwe hi gotuk, ge vineya hi gomomol moti hi kalaopop gamwanaa, kaiwena nige ali bwaga i gagan datuwa, ana yapu tabam wan handeled mita ya.
Sauga hi gotuk ge hi gailau, ginaha hi kite ge moti enuna iyoho ginaha kiyalina gamwanaa, ge beleid enuna al hi kite.
Yaka Yeisu i baek elal i ba, “Moti bolo abwe ku logel enuna ku pwatanim.”
Yaka Saimon Pita i na i ha wagaa, inoke vineya i momol tukan datuwa. Moti bwabwatal hi kalaopop vineya gamwanaa, ali gewi 153. He bwagana moti ali gewi i ola o, yaa vineya nige i mamalabu.
Yeisu i baek elal i ba, “Ku nem ku anan.” He nige bosowailiya tage etega ni nel elana ni ba, “Henala owa,” kaiwena iyaka hi atena te iya Babala.
Inoke Yeisu i nok i na beleid i ahe i pek elal, ge i ginol i ola al to moti elana.
He Yeisu wana lut al enaa, wana masal paetonina te wana tohago elal.
Yeisu I Baek Pita elana, “No Sipi Nu Matahikagil”

Sauga hi anan haba, yaka Yeisu i baek Saimon Pita elana i ba, “Saimon Diyon natuna, tab u nunuwana-agau nabiyan, ge bolo ya wali nunuwana i bwata lake?” Pita i ba, “Ibwe, Babala, u atena te ya nunuwana-agiwa.” Yaka Yeisu i baek elana i ba, “No sipi natunau nu paanil.”
Yeisu i ba paeluwana i ba, “Saimon Diyon natuna, tab u nunuwana-agau nabiyan?” Pita i ba, “Ibwe Babala, u atena te ya nunuwana-agiwa.” Yaka Yeisu i baek elana i ba, “No sipi nu matahikagil.”

Yeisu i nel paetonina Pita elana i ba, “Saimon Diyon natuna, tab u nunuwana-agau?” Pita atena i lomwan kaiwena Yeisu i nel paetonina i ba, “Tab u nunuwana-agau?” Yaka i ba, “Babala, owa bugul gegewena u atena. U atena te ya nunuwana-agiwa.” Yaka Yeisu i baek elana i ba, “No sipi nu paanil.

Ya ba tunahot eliyam, wam sauga heval totom am belet u gimwan ge u nok labi toto nuwam nu noek. Yaa bwaliga ebo nu liki, nimwam nu latahin inoke gamagal etega ni yowaniwa ge ni nuliwa nu nok labena toto nige nuwam nu noek.”
Yeisu i ba ola o ge i pamasal bwaliga Pita hauna kaba yaomal elana ni yaomala ge Yehoba alana ni pawasawasa. Inoke i baek Pita elana i ba, “U toulilau!”

Pita i tagena sikal ge tohago toto etega, toto Yeisu i nunuwana-an nabiyan, i kite i noulilem eliyaa. (He iya te valila aanan ana sauga elana i gena nok Yeisu elana ge i ba, “Babala, henala ge ni wasaagiwa?”)
Sauga Pita tohago o i kite, inoke i nel Yeisu elana i ba, “Babala, yaa tau ya nasi ga ni ola?”
Anana Yeisu i lahe i ba, “Binimala ebo nuwau iya ni mina ana siga na sikalim al, he ga i ola elam o? Owa nige wam labi i oola to. Owa u toulilau.”

Yaka wasa kakawi etega i lelu Yeisu ana tototoulil gamwaliyaa tage tohago toto o nige ni yayaomal. Yaa Yeisu nige i babaa ola te nige ni yayaomal. Yaa iya i ba, “Binimala ebo nuwau iya ni mina ana siga na sikalim al, he ga i ola elam o?”
Tohago toto ya iya te bugul bolo ya i wasaan ge i leli lowan buki ya gamwanaa. Ge ta atena iya wana wasa i tunahot.
Yeisu bugul hi gewi nabi al i ginolil. Binimala ebo maisena ge maisena leli lowanina ni gan, he ya nuwatu panayawi nige i bwabwata ge buki bolo nihi leli o abana ni gan.

footnotes.text: Diyon 13:23 ana epwamwananal paiya nu kite.
